query:
UPDATE news 
SET 
  date = '2023-07-12',
  publishedAt = '2023-07-12',
  coverImageUrl = 'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/fERZyIIjDmNcAxaN.jpg',
  blocks = JSON_ARRAY(
    JSON_OBJECT('type', 'text', 'content', 'Brandon PT Davis served as Assistant Scenic Designer for the world premiere of Bottle Shock! The Musical at California Center for the Arts Escondido. Working with scenic designer Jo Winiarski, Davis provided drafting and 3D modeling support for an innovative design that brought the romance and elegance of Napa Valley wine country to the stage.'),
    JSON_OBJECT('type', 'header', 'content', 'The Design Challenge'),
    JSON_OBJECT('type', 'text', 'content', 'The production required a versatile scenic environment that could transition seamlessly between California vineyards and Parisian wine cellars. Jo Winiarski''s design featured elegant arched alcoves reminiscent of French wine caves, complemented by warm lighting and textured surfaces that evoked both Old World sophistication and New World innovation.'),
    JSON_OBJECT('type', 'image', 'url', 'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/fERZyIIjDmNcAxaN.jpg', 'caption', 'The wine cellar set featuring elegant arched alcoves and atmospheric lighting. Photo by Karli Cadel.'),
    JSON_OBJECT('type', 'header', 'content', 'The Production'),
    JSON_OBJECT('type', 'text', 'content', 'This world premiere musical tells the story of the famous 1976 Judgment of Paris wine tasting that put California wines on the international map. The production ran July 7-23, 2023 at the Center Theatre, featuring book and lyrics by Ross Hellwig and music by Brandon Smith.'),
    JSON_OBJECT('type', 'image', 'url', 'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/HcvhJdHxjzwLcyqi.jpeg', 'caption', 'T.J. Mannix as Jim Barrett, Louis Pardo as Steven Spurrier, and Patrick Ortiz as Gustavo Brambilla in the wine cellar setting. Photo by Karli Cadel.'),
    JSON_OBJECT('type', 'team', 'title', 'Creative Team', 'members', JSON_ARRAY(
      JSON_OBJECT('role', 'Director', 'name', 'J. Scott Lapp'),
      JSON_OBJECT('role', 'Scenic Designer', 'name', 'Jo Winiarski'),
      JSON_OBJECT('role', 'Assistant Scenic Designer', 'name', 'Brandon PT Davis'),
      JSON_OBJECT('role', 'Lighting Designer', 'name', 'Zach Blane'),
      JSON_OBJECT('role', 'Costume Designer', 'name', 'Elisa Benzoni'),
      JSON_OBJECT('role', 'Sound Designer', 'name', 'Jonathan Burke')
    )),
    JSON_OBJECT('type', 'link', 'url', 'https://artcenter.org/event/bottleshockthemusical/', 'text', 'Visit California Center for the Arts')
  )
WHERE slug = 'bottle-shock-musical-ccae';
